title: Pathwise Shrinkage and Probabilistic Calibration of the Multiplicative Half-Cauchy Process
abstract: arXiv:2610.21136v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We characterize the multiplicative half-Cauchy process through its log-scale random-walk representation, establishing shrinkage, expansion, and critical regimes, almost-sure summability, local rebounds, and effective dimension. We also derive a semi-analytic calibration rule linking interpretable prior probability statements to its scale parameter.

translated_title: 乘性半柯西过程的路径收缩与概率校准
translated_abstract: 我们通过对数尺度随机游走表示来刻画乘性半柯西过程，建立了其收缩、扩张与临界区域，几乎必然可和性，局部反弹性质以及有效维度。我们还推导出一种半解析的校准规则，将可解释的先验概率陈述与其尺度参数联系起来。
tldr: 本文通过对数尺度随机游走表示系统刻画了乘性半柯西过程的收缩、扩张与临界等路径性质，并推导出连接可解释先验概率陈述与尺度参数的半解析校准规则。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes the multiplicative half-Cauchy process via its log-scale random-walk representation, establishing shrinkage, expansion, and critical regimes along with summability and effective dimension, and derives a semi-analytic calibration rule linking interpretable prior probability statements to its scale parameter.
